Name: Mayonnaise Wine
Author: elizibar
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A silly mod because the concept of just upending a jar of mayo to drink it is kind of funny, and we're going to the next level.  Turn your Mayonnaise into "Wine" or the next best thing using Kegs.[/color][/size]

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=5]Install (manually)[/size][/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game using SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds a new "Wine" item made from mayonnaise in kegs. It gives a minor buff.[/color][/size]

Aging is not currently supported, so it only comes in the default quality.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI and the Content Patcher.[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Mayo Wine
Manifest.Description: Turns mayonnaise into mayo wine via kegs.
Manifest.Author: elizibar
